description: Inline attestation signatures (badge.blue). The signed bytes are the attestation CID: the record without its signatures, with this entry (less cid and signature, plus repository = the authoring repo DID) under $sig, as DAG-CBOR, SHA-256, CIDv1 dag-cbor.

key.description: The did:key that verifies the signature.

cid.description: The attestation CID this entry signs.

signature.description: Low-S ECDSA signature over the CID bytes.

issuer.description: The DID the key signs for; the repository when absent or empty.

role.description: The role this signature attests in a multi-party workflow.

signatures.description: The signatures of a record: inline network.attested.signature entries or strong references to network.attested.proof records.
